evidence: app/ — no test files, hence no low-value tests
signal_to_noise.rationale: No tests means no noise; per the rubric this scores 3 rather than 1.

findings.issue: No test script, runner, or test files anywhere in the app; the acceptance suite is the only safety net.
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest with unit tests for lib/format.ts, the MoveTable comparator, toCards/speciesIndex against a fixture payload, and the memo cache; wire an 'npm test' script.

findings.issue: The most intricate stateful code in the app (debounce timer, lastPushed ref, live-query vs URL-query reconciliation, page reset while typing) is untested.
findings.suggestion: Extract the search-sync and pagination logic into pure functions and unit-test the races: typing then changing a filter, back/forward navigation, page clamp when filters shrink results.

findings.issue: Alternate-form exclusion (id > 10000), species dedup, and dex-number ordering live in one untested function; the spec's deoxys-normal → Deoxys mapping depends on it.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test toCards with refs including alternate forms and duplicate species, asserting ordering and exclusion.

findings.issue: Sort comparator correctness (missing-values last in both directions, stable tie-break, mixed number/string) and aria-sort state are unguarded.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the row ordering for each column with nulls present, in both directions, plus the aria-sort values.

findings.issue: Cache size cap only evicts expired entries, so under load with >5000 live keys the map grows without bound; also nothing pins that rejected promises are evicted.
findings.suggestion: Test the memo directly: failure eviction, TTL expiry, and bounded growth, then cap by inserting LRU-style eviction.

findings.issue: No errorComponent and orNull only converts 404s (pokeapi.ts:63-71); API 5xx/network failures surface as unhandled rejections with no user-facing error page and no test.
findings.suggestion: Add a defaultErrorComponent and a test that a failing API endpoint renders an error page rather than a crash.

findings.issue: englishName, latestEnglish (.at(-1)), and collapse are the spec's exact definitions yet untested; an off-by-one (first instead of last English entry) would slip through.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test these three pure functions against the documented edge cases (\n and \f collapsing, non-English entries).

findings.issue: Default game selection (games.at(-1)) and version-group order fallback (MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) are unpinned; flipping either would mostly pass sampled acceptance tests.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the version-group ordering and default selection with a synthetic move list including an unknown version group.

findings.issue: Spec-pinned formatting (stat Total sum, one-decimal height/weight) has no regression net.
findings.suggestion: Snapshot-free unit tests asserting the formatted strings for known inputs (e.g. height 4 → '0.4 m').

summary: The app ships zero tests of its own — no runner, no script, no test files. Its riskiest logic (home-page URL/search sync, the sortable move table, alternate-form exclusion and species indexing, and the request-time cache) is guarded only by the sampled acceptance suite, so a data-layer refactor could silently break form handling, sorting, and English-name selection. A thin Vitest layer over the pure helpers and server transformations would be cheap and would catch most of these.
